=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: Your permit “Visitor” now has no rego on it
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

Your permit “Visitor” has no rego on it for today, as scheduled by your roster (regos are removed on this day). No car is covered by that permit until you select a rego.

This is simply to confirm the change, and you don’t need to do anything.

To make this change, p.stonn removed GUEST1, which a booking had set. We have emailed the person whose rego that is.

We have also told sam@example.com (by email).

https://p.stonn.org
